info.title: Zscaler Private Access API Portal
info.description: To access detailed ZPA API documentation, including references and use cases, refer to the [Zscaler Help Portal](/zpa/about-zpa-api).

post.description: Bulk deletes the App Connectors for the specified customer.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

parameters.name: microtenantId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

description.description: The description of the App Connector.

fingerprint.description: The hardware fingerprint associated with the App Connector.

issuedCertId.description: The unique identifier of the issued certificate.

enabled.description: Whether or not this App Connector is enabled.

ipAcl.description: The IP Access List (IP ACL) to allow App Connectors on a specific IP address or subnet.

provisioningKeyId.description: The unique identifier of the provisioning key.

connectorType.description: Indicates if the App Connector is an App Connector (APP) or Network Connector (NP).

provisioningKeyName.description: The name of the provisioning key.

enrollmentCert.description: The enrollment certificate for the App Connector.

appConnectorGroupId.description: The unique identifier of the App Connector group.

appConnectorGroupName.description: The name of the App Connector group.

expectedVersion.description: The expected version of the App Connector. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

currentVersion.description: The current version of the App Connector. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

previousVersion.description: The previous version of the App Connector. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

lastUpgradeTime.description: The time the App Connector last upgraded. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

expectedUpgradeTime.description: The expected upgrade time for the App Connector. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

upgradeStatus.description: The status of the App Connector upgrade. Only applicable in a GET request. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

controlChannelStatus.description: The status of the control channel. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests. The expected values are UNKNOWN (0), ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED (1), and ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED (2).

upgradeAttempt.description: The number of attempts the App Connector takes to upgrade. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

ctrlBrokerName.description: The name of the Control Public Service Edge. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

lastBrokerConnectTime.description: The time the ZPA Public Service Edge last connected. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

lastBrokerConnectTimeDuration.description: The last connection time duration of the ZPA Public Service Edge. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

sargeVersion.description: The Manager software version for App Connector. To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.

lastBrokerDisconnectTime.description: The time the ZPA Public Service Edge last disconnected. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

lastBrokerDisconnectTimeDuration.description: The duration of time when the ZPA Public Service Edge last disconnected. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

enabled.description: Indicates if the setting for deleting App Connectors or ZPA Private Service Edges is enabled or disabled.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

upgradeNowOnce.description: Whether or not the App Connector is upgraded to a new version only once. If set to true, the App Connector upgrades to the new version and then resets this field to false.
